footnote_text: On September 16, 2026, ICONIQ Strategic Partners II, L.P. distributed, for no consideration, in the aggregate 3,085,037 shares of the Issuer's Class A Common Stock (the "ICONIQ II Shares") to its limited partners and to ICONIQ Strategic Partners II GP, L.P.
